drafter.private_reasoning: The draft is very brief and leaves key mutual confidentiality protections unclear. I have proposed balanced, customary protections and preserved the stated 24-month agreement term while clarifying the confidentiality period. No confidential client threshold is relevant or disclosed.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thanks for circulating the first draft. To keep the process moving, we have proposed a few customary clarifications addressing permitted use and disclosure, exclusions, compelled disclosure, and return or destruction of information. We have retained the 24-month agreement term and clarified the duration of the confidentiality obligations. Please let us know if these revisions work for your client.

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE; CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. The parties wish to evaluate and, if appropriate, negotiate a potential transaction (the “Purpose”). “Confidential Information” means nonpublic information disclosed by or on behalf of a party or its representatives (the “Disclosing Party”) to the other party or its representatives (the “Receiving Party”), in any form, that is designated confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential given its nature or the circumstances of disclosure. It includes the existence and status of discussions concerning the Purpose and the terms of this Agreement. The Receiving Party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and shall not disclose it except as permitted under this Agreement. Confidential Information does not include information the Receiving Party can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes publicly available through no breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to it without restriction before disclosure; (c) is received lawfully from a third party without a duty of confidentiality; or (d) is independently developed without use of or reference to Confidential Information.
edits.name: Purpose and definition

edits.text: 2. PROTECTION; PERMITTED DISCLOSURES. The Receiving Party shall protect Confidential Information using at least reasonable care and no less than the care it uses to protect its own similarly sensitive information. It may disclose Confidential Information only to its and its affiliates’ directors, officers, employees, financing sources, and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations or professional duties at least as protective as this Agreement. The Receiving Party is responsible for its representatives’ compliance with this Agreement. If disclosure is required by law, regulation, or legal process, the Receiving Party may disclose only the portion legally required and, to the extent legally permitted, shall give the Disclosing Party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate, at the Disclosing Party’s expense, in seeking protective treatment. Upon written request, the Receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information, except that it may retain copies required by law or maintained in routine backup systems, which remain subject to this Agreement.
edits.name: Protection and permitted disclosures

edits.text: 3. TERM; SURVIVAL. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing. The obligations concerning each item of Confidential Information continue for three years from its disclosure; provided that information qualifying as a trade secret under applicable law shall remain protected for so long as it retains that status. Expiration or termination of this Agreement does not affect obligations that by their terms survive.
edits.name: Term and survival

edits.text: 4. REMEDIES; NO OBLIGATION. A breach may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages may be inadequate, and the Disclosing Party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief, in addition to any other remedies available at law, subject to applicable law and the court’s discretion. Neither party is obligated to proceed with any transaction, and either may discontinue discussions at any time. No license or other rights in Confidential Information are granted except the limited right to use it for the Purpose. Confidential Information is provided without representation or warranty as to its accuracy or completeness, except as may be expressly set out in a definitive written agreement.
edits.name: Remedies and other terms

receiver.message_back: The clarifications are generally acceptable, but we cannot agree to confidentiality obligations expiring three years after disclosure; please extend them to five years, with trade secrets protected for so long as they remain trade secrets. Please also require return or destruction upon request (with written confirmation), allowing routine-backup and legally required copies only to the extent they cannot reasonably be deleted and subject to continuing protection.

drafter.private_reasoning: Accept the requested five-year confidentiality period, continuing trade-secret protection, and return/destruction mechanics, while limiting retained copies to those that cannot reasonably be deleted and keeping them protected.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We have revised the draft to provide five years of protection from disclosure, with trade secrets protected for so long as they remain trade secrets. We have also clarified that, upon request, the receiving party must promptly return or destroy the information and confirm completion in writing, subject only to the limited backup and legally required retention exceptions you proposed.

That indicates their current proposal, not necessarily their confidential bottom line.
